review:
Power of Thor Megaways is a Norse Megaways slot with up to 117,649 ways. Its signature feature is the hammer: when it lands horizontally on the top row, every symbol beneath it turns wild, which can create big base-game wins.

Free spins have an unusual trigger. Instead of a fixed number of scatters, you need the scatter letters to spell THOR on screen. During the free games, a multiplier increases with every tumble, so long cascade chains are what make the bonus valuable. The advertised maximum is 5,000x and the RTP is 96.55%. The hammer gives the base game real moments, which isn't true of every Megaways title.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
